evals.name: many-independent-items-is-a-workflow
evals.prompt: I need every one of the 140 skill files under plugins/ checked for a missing ## Gotchas section and a one-line fix proposed for each. Should this be a workflow?
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/workflow-availability.sh, checks that the Workflow tool is among the callable tools, and answers in three lines: `verdict: workflow`, a reason naming the 140 independent items, and `shape: sections`. Writes no file and launches nothing.
expectations: The bundled workflow-availability.sh is run before the verdict
The verdict also rests on whether the Workflow tool is actually callable, not on the script alone
The output is the verdict, reason and shape lines, with the item count in the reason and shape: sections
No workflow is launched and no file is written

evals.name: disabled-workflows-downgrade
evals.prompt: Should I run a workflow to audit all 60 hook scripts for unquoted variables? Note CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 is set in this shell.
evals.expected_output: The script reports `verdict off` for the environment variable. The answer is `verdict: subagent` with a reason that names the 60 items and the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS switch as the downgrade.
expectations: The verdict is subagent, not workflow
The reason names the switch that turned workflows off
The skill does not suggest unsetting the variable as part of the verdict

evals.name: small-dependent-task-is-single
evals.prompt: Should I use a workflow to rename one function and update its two callers in the same file?
evals.expected_output: `verdict: single` with a reason saying the task is one dependent chain that fits this context.
expectations: The reason names the small size and the dependent shape, not the topic
No subagent or workflow is started

evals.name: run-shape-race-rule
evals.prompt: I want four subagents to each write a fix for the same flaky test from the same brief, and then I'll keep the best one. How should this run?
evals.expected_output: A `subagent` verdict (four delegated tasks fit the turn) with a third line `shape: race (no selection rule stated)`. The reason says the race must not start until a selection rule (first to pass a stated check, rank all, or best-of a stated criterion) is stated, because 'the best one' names no criterion.
expectations: A third line starts with shape: race
The answer says no selection rule was stated and asks for one before any agent is spawned

evals.name: run-shape-single-no-line
evals.prompt: Should I fan out to fix a typo in one README heading?
evals.expected_output: Exactly two lines: `verdict: single` and a reason naming the one-line edit. No `shape:` line, because a single-context task has no run shape.
expectations: The output is exactly two lines
